subject: QA PASS: localStorage inline confirmation (commit de874d2)
body:
QA PASS.

All 6 acceptance criteria met:
1. startClearConfirm() hides action row, shows confirmation row -- PASS
2. cancelClearConfirm() reverts -- PASS
3. Escape key triggers cancelClearConfirm() -- PASS
4. window.confirm() completely removed -- PASS (searched, no match)
5. prefers-reduced-motion guard on fade animation -- PASS (line 181)
6. startClearConfirm() sets focus to first confirmation button -- PASS

Bonus: focus management (moving focus to first confirm button) was not in the spec but is the correct WCAG 2.4.3 behavior for inline dialogs. Good call.

Spec 20260224-0000 closed.
